instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after command, report, screenshot, trace, or log evidence exists.

features.description: Industry research, current assistant architecture, current gaps, requirements, and phase boundaries are captured in a durable source packet.
steps: Read product-design:index and prd-phase-harness instructions.
Inspect existing assistant PRD docs, assistant-service runtime, skills, MCP, memory, RAG, and frontend assistant files.
Search current industry sources for Codex, Claude Code, MCP, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent patterns.
Write source packet, continuity ledger, manifest, feature oracle, and baseline report.
features.notes: This proves the PRD baseline only. Implementation features remain failing until their assigned phases execute.

features.description: The assistant has one canonical streaming-first agent harness contract with run lifecycle, policy routing, capability selection, tool execution, memory/context writeback, and durable event evidence.
steps: Read AgentLoop, AssistantExecutionGateway, request router, middleware, tool invoker, and relevant tests.
Clarify or implement the minimum run-state and event contract without reviving a heavy planner-by-default loop.
Add deterministic tests for lifecycle events, policy decisions, tool gates, context-budget events, and failure states.
features.notes: Streaming-first AgentLoop now emits redacted context_budget evidence and canonical tool_call_start/tool_call_result/tool_call_end aliases while preserving the existing loop and legacy events. NGA-01 remains partial because NGA-F003 is still pending.

features.description: Every assistant run produces inspectable trace and activity records that can support UI timelines, debugging, evals, and release reviews.
steps: Inspect current run events, gateway execution persistence, RAG/context metrics, and UI event handling.
Define the minimum event schema for run_started, gateway_decision, tool_call_start/end, approval_required/result, context_compacted, artifact_created, run_finished, and run_error.
Verify traces/events are emitted without leaking secrets.
features.notes: Streaming-first AgentLoop trace/activity records now carry run/session correlation across lifecycle, gateway, context, approval, tool, artifact, compaction, finish, and error events. Event-facing auth/key/token/password text is redacted. Broad phase ruff still has documented pre-existing lint debt.

features.description: Skills are discoverable, progressively loaded, tool-callable when appropriate, versioned, testable, and visible enough for users and operators to trust.
steps: Inspect runtime skill registry, filesystem skills, SkillToolBridge, skill creation, and skill selection.
Implement or specify catalog, enable/disable, triggered-skill visibility, test-before-enable, and rollback behavior.
Add tests for progressive disclosure and skill execution boundaries.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-f004-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-f004-critic.md. Phase report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-report.md.
features.notes: SkillToolBridge now publishes bounded capability metadata, trigger-derived relevance keywords, version/source execution metadata, and additive /tools catalog fields without serializing full skill instructions. Focused red/green tests, required focused pytest, narrow changed-file ruff, and web type-check passed. Broad NGA-02 ruff remains blocked by existing wider-scope lint debt.

features.description: MCP servers and tools are tenant-scoped, risk-labelled, auditable, and loaded through a token-efficient selection path.
steps: Inspect MCPManager, MCP client/config, tenant MCP config, tool selector, tool invoker, and audit logging.
Make default tenant policy explicit and testable.
Verify MCP tool descriptions, resource outputs, failures, and approvals are safe and user-visible.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-f005-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-f005-critic.md. Phase report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-report.md.
features.notes: TenantMCPConfigService now defaults missing/failed tenant MCP policy to deny-all and records policy_source. Factory-created invokers install default-deny MCP policy. Denied MCP calls are audited without executing the external tool. MCP registrations expose bounded, redacted, tenant-scoped catalog metadata. Focused red/green tests, required focused pytest, narrow changed-file ruff, and web type-check passed. Broad NGA-02 ruff remains blocked by existing wider-scope lint debt.

features.description: Repeated successful workflows can become reviewed procedural memory or skills without unsafe self-modification.
steps: Inspect skill_create, memory, audit, approval, and sandbox policy code.
Design a propose-review-test-enable loop for learned skills.
Verify generated skills cannot run without independent critic evidence, eval evidence, and rollback metadata.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-f006-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-f006-critic.md. Phase report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-02-skills-and-mcp-capability-layer-report.md.
features.notes: Generated skills now carry lifecycle, review, eval, and rollback metadata. Parsed user SKILL.md content defaults to proposed/disabled, registry save/register paths fail closed without independent critic evidence, eval evidence, and rollback metadata, and catalog entries expose review-required state without full instructions. Focused red/green tests, required focused pytest, narrow changed-file ruff, and web type-check passed. Broad NGA-02 ruff remains blocked by existing wider-scope lint debt.

features.description: Procedural, situational, and semantic memory have explicit storage, retrieval, privacy, inspect, delete, and prompt-injection boundaries.
steps: Inspect MemoryManager, MemoryService, runtime memory v2, memory tool, preference extractor, working memory, and tests.
Define and implement memory profiles: off, basic, hybrid.
Add tests for tenant scope, PII filtering, explicit recall, delete, and memory prompt boundaries.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-f007-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-f007-critic.md. Phase report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-report.md.
features.notes: MemoryManager now supports off/basic/hybrid profiles and procedural/situational/semantic memory types. Long-term write/recall is profile-gated, delete remains explicit, metadata records type/profile/scope/privacy/trust, values are sanitized for email/phone PII and prompt-control text, runtime markdown memory source deletion is tenant/user confined, and the memory tool is profile-aware without echoing raw values. Focused F007 tests, required memory/context pytest, required safety pytest, and changed-file ruff passed. Required broad NGA-03 ruff remains blocked by 23 existing wider-scope lint errors outside changed F007 files. NGA-03 remains partial because NGA-F008 and NGA-F009 are still pending.

features.description: RAG handles KB, session files, generated artifacts, web/MCP outputs, and citations through scoped retrieval and source-aware context budgets.
steps: Inspect RAG context engine, scenario retriever, query intent analyzer, KB proxy, file processor, and knowledge-service retrieval tests.
Complete or block session-level temporary KB behavior for long uploaded files.
Verify citations, freshness, tenant boundaries, and no over-retrieval.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-f008-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-f008-critic.md. Phase report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-report.md.
features.notes: FileProcessor now hands long uploaded files marked for RAG to create_session_kb and attaches the returned session_kb_id when an injected create_session_dataset KB proxy is available. Session KB metadata records source_type session_file, freshness, and tenant/user/session scope; missing or unsupported proxies fail safe with None. ScenarioRetrievalContext formatting now preserves bounded source type, citation, freshness, dataset, chunk, tenant, user, and session metadata. Focused F008 red/green tests, required NGA-03 memory/context pytest, required safety pytest, and broad NGA-03 ruff passed after mechanical lint cleanup in phase validation paths. NGA-03 remains partial because NGA-F009 is still pending.

features.description: Context assembly uses stable prefixes, budget events, compaction, deferred tools, memory indexes, and source summaries without bloating every turn.
steps: Inspect ContextBudgetManager, ContextEngine, compressor, runtime context v2, and streaming-first prompt assembly.
Define the minimal context packet and budget telemetry per run.
Add tests for compaction, preserved tool results, skill snippets, memory snippets, and current-request context.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-f009-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-f009-critic.md. Phase report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-03-memory-rag-and-context-foundation-report.md.
features.notes: ContextAssemblyPlan budget events now include deterministic context packet order and compaction details. ContextAssemblerV2 accepts bounded source summaries, tool-result summaries, artifact summaries, and compaction summary while preserving existing RAG/current context first and avoiding raw full-output prompt stuffing. ContextCostBreakdown now attributes source summaries, tool results, artifacts, and compaction as separate contributor categories. Focused F009 red/green test, required NGA-03 memory/context pytest, required safety pytest, broad NGA-03 ruff, strict harness validation, and NGA-03 completion gate passed.

features.description: The assistant UI exposes plan/review/execute flow, live activity, approvals, selected capabilities, context/memory state, and artifact recovery.
steps: Inspect assistant page, ActivityPanel, Timeline, ConnectorsPanel, CustomizeDialog, session hooks, SSE event parsing, and API clients.
Implement one bounded UX slice that makes agent state inspectable and controllable.
Verify with Playwright, typecheck, lint, and build.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-assistant-ux-and-session-experience-f010-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-assistant-ux-and-session-experience-f010-critic.md. Rendered desktop/mobile screenshots: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-f010-rendered-desktop.png and docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-f010-rendered-mobile.png.
features.notes: Activity now derives rows from processSummary steps/tools, context budget/compaction, retrieved contexts, and generated artifacts. Legacy task_planning and working_memory_update events mirror into processSummary for V2 visibility. Approval events create visible process-summary tool rows even when the approval is the first tool signal. Mobile uses the existing ActivityPanel in a bottom sheet. Focused F010 Playwright red/green passed; type-check/lint/build, required API pytest, JSON checks, git diff --check, and strict harness validation passed. Full listed e2e command was run but remains environment-limited because the real local e2e stack requires POSTGRES_PASSWORD/REDIS_PASSWORD and the lightweight stub lacks backend memory/history/playground behavior.

features.description: Conversations support durable resume, branch/fork, share, artifact continuity, feedback, and session-safe memory behavior.
steps: Inspect session manager, conversation sidebar, useChatSession, session APIs, share flows, and artifact handling.
Add or refine user flows for resume/fork/share and feedback-driven improvement.
Verify protected routes, tenant ownership, and browser recovery states.
features.evidence: Actor report: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-assistant-ux-and-session-experience-f011-report.md. Critic artifact: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-assistant-ux-and-session-experience-f011-critic.md. Rendered desktop/mobile screenshots: docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-f011-rendered-desktop.png and docs/general_ai_assistant_next_gen/reports/nga-04-f011-rendered-mobile.png.
features.notes: Restored sessions now use a unique artifact affordance count across persisted artifacts and reconstructed current-run output files. The assistant Playwright harness can preload session history/artifacts/share responses, and the focused F011 red/green test verifies durable resume, inline artifact recovery, Artifacts chip count, Share dialog artifact count, and include_artifacts share payload. Frontend type-check/lint/build, required API pytest, focused Playwright, rendered desktop/mobile checks, JSON checks, git diff --check, strict harness validation, and NGA-04 completion gate passed. Full listed e2e remains environment-limited locally because the real stack requires POSTGRES_PASSWORD/REDIS_PASSWORD and the lightweight stub lacks backend memory/history/playground behavior.

features.description: The upgraded assistant has golden evals, safety gates, observability checks, deployment readiness, rollback, and whole-demand regression evidence.
steps: Inspect assistant golden tests, guardrail tests, tool tests, Playwright tests, compose config, validation scripts, and release docs.
Run targeted and whole-demand regression across completed feature-oracle items.
Record release decision, rollback plan, residual risk, and blocked external gates.
features.notes: Assistant safety pytest passed with 122 tests; assistant integration passed with 3 passed and 5 environment-specific skips; frontend type-check/lint/build/e2e:opensource passed; docker compose config passed with .env.example. External env validation still fails for REDIS_PASSWORD, DOCGEN_ARTIFACT_SIGN_KEY, DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD, AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN, KNOWLEDGE_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS_JSON, and ASSISTANT_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS_JSON; make validate stops at the same config gate before runtime checks. User instructed "那先不管", so the repeated external env gate is waived/deferred for harness completion only. Terminal completion gate passed with quality score 100 after waiver writeback. Production release readiness remains unproven until those gates pass.
